title: Ish yozishmalari va hisobotlar
goal_uz: Dars oxirida aniq bo‘limlarga ega hisobot tuza olasiz, natijalar va tavsiyalarni to‘g‘ri grammatik shakllarda yozasiz, rasmiy xatni to‘g‘ri murojaat, ochilish va yakun bilan yozasiz hamda ortiqcha so‘zlarni qisqartirib, lo‘nda professional uslubda ifodalaysiz.

scenes.title: Professional yozuv
board: Business correspondence & reports
(Ish yozishmalari va hisobotlar)
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda to‘liq ergash gaplarni ixcham, kesimsiz birikmalarga aylantirishni o‘rgandik. Bugun bu ixchamlik ish yozuvida juda asqotadi. Hisobot tuzilishini, rasmiy xat qoidalarini, natija va tavsiya tilini ko‘ramiz. Dars oxirida tavsiyalari bor qisqa hisobot va unga ilova xat yoza olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back. Last time we worked on reduced clauses. Today we put that concision to work in business writing: reports, formal emails, findings and recommendations.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan safar qisqartirilgan birikmalar ustida ishladik. Bugun bu ixchamlikni ish yozuvida qo‘llaymiz: hisobotlar, rasmiy xatlar, natijalar va tavsiyalar.

scenes.title: Hisobot nima uchun yoziladi?
board: Report: facts → conclusions → action
Essay: argument and opinion
Reader: busy, wants answers fast

examples.t: This report evaluates the new booking system.
examples.uz: Ushbu hisobot yangi bron qilish tizimini baholaydi.

scenes.say_native: Hisobot inshodan farq qiladi. Insho fikrni asoslaydi, hisobot esa faktlarni yig‘ib, xulosa chiqaradi va harakatni taklif qiladi. Hisobotni o‘qiydigan odam odatda band rahbar. U hamma narsani o‘qimaydi, faqat kerakli bo‘limni qidiradi. Shuning uchun hisobotda sarlavhalar, aniq tuzilma va lo‘nda gaplar majburiy.
scenes.say: An essay argues a point of view. A report presents facts, draws conclusions and proposes action. Its reader is usually busy, so it must be easy to scan.
scenes.say_uz: Insho nuqtai nazarni asoslaydi. Hisobot faktlarni beradi, xulosa chiqaradi va harakat taklif qiladi. O‘quvchisi odatda band, shuning uchun uni tez ko‘zdan kechirish oson bo‘lishi kerak.

scenes.title: Hisobot tuzilishi
board: 1 Introduction (purpose, method)
2 Findings
3 Conclusions
4 Recommendations

examples.t: 1. Introduction  2. Findings  3. Conclusions  4. Recommendations
examples.uz: 1. Kirish  2. Natijalar  3. Xulosalar  4. Tavsiyalar

scenes.say_native: Klassik hisobot to‘rt qismdan iborat. Kirish: maqsad va ma’lumot qanday yig‘ilgani. Findings: aniqlangan faktlar, raqamlar, xulosasiz. Conclusions: bu faktlar nimani anglatadi. Recommendations: nima qilish kerak. Uzun hisobotda boshida executive summary ham bo‘ladi, ya’ni bir xatboshida butun hisobotning qisqa mazmuni.
scenes.say: A typical report has four parts: an introduction, findings, conclusions and recommendations. Longer reports often open with an executive summary.
scenes.say_uz: Odatiy hisobot to‘rt qismdan iborat: kirish, natijalar, xulosalar va tavsiyalar. Uzunroq hisobotlar ko‘pincha qisqacha xulosa bilan boshlanadi.

scenes.title: Kirish qismi
board: The aim / purpose of this report is to…
This report examines / evaluates / outlines…
It is based on a survey of 120 employees.

examples.t: The aim of this report is to assess staff satisfaction with remote working.
examples.uz: Ushbu hisobotning maqsadi xodimlarning masofaviy ishdan qoniqishini baholash.

examples.t: It is based on interviews with ten department heads.
examples.uz: U o‘nta bo‘lim boshlig‘i bilan suhbatlarga asoslangan.

scenes.say_native: Kirish ikki-uch gapdan oshmaydi va darhol maqsadni aytadi: the aim of this report is to, yoki this report examines. Keyin ma’lumot manbai: it is based on a survey of one hundred and twenty employees. Shaxsiy hikoya, uzun tarix yoki umumiy gaplar kerak emas. Fe’llarga e’tibor bering: assess, evaluate, examine, outline.
scenes.say: The aim of this report is to assess staff satisfaction with remote working. It is based on a survey of one hundred and twenty employees.
scenes.say_uz: Ushbu hisobotning maqsadi xodimlarning masofaviy ishdan qoniqishini baholash. U bir yuz yigirma xodim o‘rtasidagi so‘rovnomaga asoslangan.

scenes.title: Sarlavha, raqam va shaxssiz uslub
board: clear headings + numbered sections
bullet points for lists
impersonal: It was found that… / Staff reported…

examples.t: It was found that most delays occurred on Mondays.
examples.uz: Kechikishlarning ko‘pi dushanba kunlari bo‘lgani aniqlandi.

scenes.say_native: Hisobotning tashqi ko‘rinishi ham muhim. Har bir bo‘limga aniq sarlavha va raqam bering. Ro‘yxatlarni bullet points bilan bering, lekin butun hisobotni ro‘yxatga aylantirmang. Uslub shaxssiz: I think emas, it was found that yoki staff reported. Majhul nisbat bu yerda o‘rinli, chunki kim aniqlagani emas, nima aniqlangani muhim.
scenes.say: Use clear, numbered headings and keep the tone impersonal. It was found that most delays occurred on Mondays.
scenes.say_uz: Aniq, raqamlangan sarlavhalar ishlating va shaxssiz ohangni saqlang. Kechikishlarning ko‘pi dushanbada bo‘lgani aniqlandi.

scenes.title: O‘zbek rasmiy uslubi bilan qiyos
board: Uzbek: long formal opening, context first
English: purpose in the first sentence
Main point first, details later
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek rasmiy hujjatlarida ko‘pincha uzun kirish bo‘ladi: qaror va buyruqlarga havola, umumiy holat, keyingina asosiy masala. Ingliz ish yozuvida aksincha: asosiy fikr birinchi gapda. O‘quvchi birinchi xatboshini o‘qib, nima haqida va nima kerakligini bilishi shart.
scenes.say: In English business writing, put the main point first. The reader should know the purpose of the document after the first sentence.
scenes.say_uz: Ingliz ish yozuvida asosiy fikrni birinchi qo‘ying. O‘quvchi birinchi gapdan keyin hujjat maqsadini bilishi kerak.

scenes.title: Hisobotdagi tipik xatolar
board: ✗ In this report I will tell you about… → ✓ This report examines…
✗ Findings: …so I think we should… → ✓ keep opinions for Conclusions
✗ no headings, one long text → ✓ numbered sections
scenes.say_native: Uchta tipik xato. Birinchisi, og‘zaki kirish: in this report I will tell you about. Bu suhbat uslubi, to‘g‘risi: this report examines. Ikkinchisi, natijalar bo‘limida fikr bildirish: findings faqat fakt, so I think we should esa tavsiyalarga tegishli. Uchinchisi, sarlavhasiz bitta uzun matn.
scenes.say: Not: in this report I will tell you about, but: this report examines. Keep opinions out of the findings, and always use headings.
scenes.say_uz: In this report I will tell you about emas, this report examines. Natijalar bo‘limiga fikr qo‘shmang va doim sarlavha ishlating.

scenes.title: Bo‘limni aniqlang
board: a) 64% of customers waited over ten minutes.
b) The company should hire two more staff.
c) This report evaluates customer service at our branch.
d) Waiting times are the main cause of complaints.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Ekranda to‘rtta gap bor. Har biri hisobotning qaysi bo‘limiga tegishli ekanini aniqlang: kirish, natijalar, xulosalar yoki tavsiyalar. Natija bilan xulosani farqlang: natija faktni aytadi, xulosa esa fakt nimani anglatishini. Javoblarni to‘g‘ri tartibda ayting.
scenes.say: Match each sentence to a section of the report: introduction, findings, conclusions or recommendations. Then put them in the right order.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapni hisobot bo‘limiga moslang: kirish, natijalar, xulosalar yoki tavsiyalar. Keyin ularni to‘g‘ri tartibga qo‘ying.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: c) Introduction
a) Findings
d) Conclusions
b) Recommendations
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. C gap kirish, chunki maqsadni aytadi: this report evaluates. A gap natija: foiz, ya’ni sof fakt. D gap xulosa: u faktni talqin qiladi, ya’ni kutish vaqti shikoyatlarning asosiy sababi. B gap tavsiya: should hire. Demak, to‘g‘ri tartib c, a, d, b.
scenes.say: Sentence c is the introduction. Sentence a is a finding. Sentence d is a conclusion. Sentence b is a recommendation. So the order is c, a, d, b.
scenes.say_uz: C gap kirish. A gap natija. D gap xulosa. B gap tavsiya. Demak tartib: c, a, d, b.

scenes.title: Rasmiy xat: murojaat va yakun
board: Dear Mr Karimov, → Yours sincerely,
Dear Sir or Madam, → Yours faithfully,
Less formal: Kind regards / Best regards

examples.t: Dear Ms Rahimova,
examples.uz: Hurmatli Rahimova xonim,

examples.t: Dear Sir or Madam,
examples.uz: Hurmatli janob yoki xonim,

scenes.say_native: Endi rasmiy xat. Britaniya qoidasi: agar ismini bilsangiz, Dear Mr Karimov va oxirida Yours sincerely. Bilmasangiz, Dear Sir or Madam va Yours faithfully. Amerikada ko‘pincha Sincerely yoziladi. Elektron pochtada Kind regards yoki Best regards keng tarqalgan. Ayolga Ms deyiladi, chunki u turmush holatini bildirmaydi. Britaniyada Mr va Ms dan keyin nuqta qo‘yilmaydi, Amerikada qo‘yiladi.
scenes.say: If you know the name, write Dear Mr Karimov and end with Yours sincerely. If you don’t, write Dear Sir or Madam and end with Yours faithfully.
scenes.say_uz: Ismini bilsangiz, Dear Mr Karimov deb yozing va Yours sincerely bilan yakunlang. Bilmasangiz, Dear Sir or Madam deb yozing va Yours faithfully bilan yakunlang.

scenes.title: Xatning ochilishi
board: I am writing to enquire about / regarding…
Further to our phone call yesterday, …
Thank you for your email of 3 May.

examples.t: I am writing regarding the invoice dated 12 March.
examples.uz: 12 mart sanali hisob-faktura yuzasidan yozmoqdaman.

examples.t: Further to our meeting on Tuesday, I attach the revised budget.
examples.uz: Seshanba kungi uchrashuvimiz davomi sifatida yangilangan byudjetni ilova qilaman.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi gap xat sababini aytadi. I am writing to enquire about, ya’ni surishtirish uchun yozmoqdaman. I am writing regarding, ya’ni yuzasidan. Agar oldin aloqa bo‘lgan bo‘lsa, further to our phone call, ya’ni telefon suhbatimiz davomi sifatida. Javob xatida esa thank you for your email of third May. Rasmiy xatda qisqartma ishlatilmaydi: I am, I’m emas.
scenes.say: I am writing regarding the invoice dated twelfth March. Further to our meeting on Tuesday, I attach the revised budget.
scenes.say_uz: 12 mart sanali hisob-faktura yuzasidan yozmoqdaman. Seshanba kungi uchrashuvimiz davomi sifatida yangilangan byudjetni ilova qilaman.

scenes.title: Muloyim so‘rov
board: I would be grateful if you could + V
Could you please confirm…?
Please find attached… / I attach…

examples.t: I would be grateful if you could send the contract by Friday.
examples.uz: Shartnomani juma kunigacha yuborsangiz, minnatdor bo‘lardim.

examples.t: Please find attached the minutes of the meeting.
examples.uz: Yig‘ilish bayonnomasi ilova qilingan.

scenes.say_native: So‘rovni muloyim qilishning eng rasmiy usuli: I would be grateful if you could, keyin fe’lning birinchi shakli. Biroz yumshoqroq: could you please confirm. Ilova uchun please find attached yoki oddiy I attach, ikkalasi ham to‘g‘ri. Send me the contract kabi buyruq ohangi ingliz ish yozuvida qo‘pol eshitiladi, hatto please qo‘shilsa ham.
scenes.say: I would be grateful if you could send the contract by Friday. Please find attached the minutes of the meeting.
scenes.say_uz: Shartnomani jumagacha yuborsangiz, minnatdor bo‘lardim. Yig‘ilish bayonnomasi ilova qilingan.

scenes.title: Xatning yakuni
board: I look forward to hearing from you.
Please do not hesitate to contact me…
Should you have any questions, … (= If you have)

examples.t: Should you require any further information, please let me know.
examples.uz: Qo‘shimcha ma’lumot kerak bo‘lsa, menga xabar bering.

scenes.say_native: Yakunlovchi gaplar. I look forward to hearing from you: javobingizni kutaman. E’tibor bering, to bu yerda predlog, shuning uchun -ing keladi. Please do not hesitate to contact me: men bilan bog‘lanishdan tortinmang. Juda rasmiy shart uchun inversiya: should you have any questions, ya’ni if you have any questions.
scenes.say: I look forward to hearing from you. Should you require any further information, please do not hesitate to contact me.
scenes.say_uz: Javobingizni kutaman. Qo‘shimcha ma’lumot kerak bo‘lsa, men bilan bog‘lanishdan tortinmang.

scenes.title: Murojaat: o‘zbekcha va inglizcha
board: Hurmatli Akmal Karimovich! → Dear Mr Karimov,
Mr / Ms + surname, never + first name
First name only if they sign with it
scenes.say_native: O‘zbekchada rasmiy murojaat ism va ota ismi bilan: hurmatli Akmal Karimovich. Ingliz tilida esa Mr yoki Ms faqat familiya bilan ishlatiladi: Dear Mr Karimov. Dear Mr Akmal xato. Agar suhbatdoshingiz o‘z xatini faqat ism bilan imzolasa, keyingi xatda Dear Akmal deyishingiz mumkin. Yana bir farq: inglizcha murojaatdan keyin vergul qo‘yiladi, undov belgisi emas.
scenes.say: Use a title with the surname: Dear Mr Karimov. If someone signs with their first name, you can reply with Dear Akmal.
scenes.say_uz: Unvonni familiya bilan ishlating: Dear Mr Karimov. Kimdir faqat ismi bilan imzolasa, Dear Akmal deb javob berishingiz mumkin.

scenes.title: Rasmiy xatdagi xatolar
board: ✗ Dear Mr Akmal → ✓ Dear Mr Karimov
✗ Dear Sir or Madam … Yours sincerely → ✓ Yours faithfully
✗ I look forward to hear from you → ✓ hearing
scenes.say_native: Eng ko‘p uchraydigan uchta xato. Birinchisi, Mr va ism: Dear Mr Akmal emas, Dear Mr Karimov. Ikkinchisi, murojaat va yakun mos emas: Dear Sir or Madam bilan Yours sincerely Britaniya qoidasiga zid, Yours faithfully kerak. Uchinchisi, look forward to hear: bu yerda to predlog, shuning uchun hearing.
scenes.say: Not: Dear Mr Akmal, but Dear Mr Karimov. Not: I look forward to hear from you, but I look forward to hearing from you.
scenes.say_uz: Dear Mr Akmal emas, Dear Mr Karimov. I look forward to hear from you emas, I look forward to hearing from you.

scenes.title: Xatni tuzating
board: Dear Mrs Dilnoza,
I write you about the order. Send me the new price list.
I look forward to receive your answer.
Yours faithfully, Bekzod Aliyev
scenes.say_native: Ekrandagi qisqa xatda kamida beshta xato bor: murojaatda, ochilishda, so‘rovda, yakunlovchi gapda va xayrlashuvda. Ular grammatik ham, uslubiy ham. Har birini toping va to‘g‘ri, rasmiy variantni ayting. Oluvchining familiyasi Yusupova deb hisoblang. Javobni to‘liq xat sifatida ayting.
scenes.say: Find at least five mistakes in this short email and correct them. The recipient’s surname is Yusupova.
scenes.say_uz: Bu qisqa xatdagi kamida beshta xatoni toping va tuzating. Oluvchining familiyasi Yusupova.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: Dear Ms Yusupova,
I am writing regarding my order. I would be grateful if you could send me the new price list.
I look forward to receiving your reply.
Yours sincerely, Bekzod Aliyev
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Murojaat: Dear Ms Yusupova, familiya bilan va Ms. Ochilish: I write you emas, I am writing regarding my order. So‘rov: send me buyrug‘i o‘rniga I would be grateful if you could send me. Yakun: look forward to receiving. Va ism ma’lum bo‘lgani uchun Yours sincerely.
scenes.say: Dear Ms Yusupova. I am writing regarding my order. I would be grateful if you could send me the new price list. I look forward to receiving your reply. Yours sincerely, Bekzod Aliyev.
scenes.say_uz: Hurmatli Yusupova xonim. Buyurtmam yuzasidan yozmoqdaman. Yangi narxlar ro‘yxatini yuborsangiz, minnatdor bo‘lardim. Javobingizni kutaman. Hurmat bilan, Bekzod Aliyev.

scenes.title: Tinglash: shikoyatga javob
board: Manager & assistant
A client complaint about a late delivery
(mijoz shikoyati: kechikkan yetkazib berish)
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialog. Menejer va yordamchi mijozning shikoyatiga javob xatini muhokama qilmoqda. Tinglang: mijoz nimadan norozi, xatda nima taklif qilinadi va menejer qaysi iborani o‘zgartirishni so‘raydi. Keyin savollarga javob berasiz. Uzr qanday bo‘lishi kerakligiga alohida e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Assistant: The client says the delivery was a week late. Should I start with an apology? Manager: Yes, but keep it brief. Then explain what we’re doing about it. Offer free delivery on the next order. Assistant: I wrote: we are sorry for any inconvenience. Manager: Too vague. Say: we apologise for the delay to your order. And end with a named contact, not just the team.
scenes.say_uz: Yordamchi: Mijoz yetkazib berish bir hafta kechikdi deyapti. Uzr bilan boshlaymi? Menejer: Ha, lekin qisqa. Keyin nima qilayotganimizni tushuntiring. Keyingi buyurtmaga bepul yetkazib berishni taklif qiling. Yordamchi: Men har qanday noqulaylik uchun uzr so‘raymiz deb yozdim. Menejer: Juda mavhum. Buyurtmangiz kechikkani uchun uzr so‘raymiz deng. Va oxirida jamoa emas, aniq mas’ul shaxsni ko‘rsating.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1) What is the client’s complaint?
2) What will the company offer?
3) Why does the manager reject the first apology?
4) How should the email end?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Mijoz nimadan shikoyat qilmoqda? Kompaniya qanday kompensatsiya taklif qiladi? Menejer nega yordamchining birinchi uzr gapini rad etdi? Va xat qanday yakunlanishi kerak? Javoblarni inglizcha, to‘liq gap bilan ayting. Iloji bo‘lsa, dialogdagi iboralarni ishlating.
scenes.say: What is the client’s complaint? What will the company offer? Why does the manager reject the first apology? How should the email end?
scenes.say_uz: Mijozning shikoyati nima? Kompaniya nimani taklif qiladi? Menejer nega birinchi uzrni rad etadi? Xat qanday tugashi kerak?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) The delivery was a week late.
2) Free delivery on the next order.
3) It is too vague.
4) With a named contact person.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Mijoz yetkazib berish bir hafta kechikkanidan norozi. Kompaniya keyingi buyurtmaga bepul yetkazib berishni taklif qiladi. We are sorry for any inconvenience juda mavhum, chunki aniq nima uchun uzr so‘ralayotgani aytilmagan. Aniq uzr ishonch uyg‘otadi. Va xat aniq mas’ul shaxsning ismi bilan tugashi kerak, shunda mijoz kimga yozishni biladi.
scenes.say: The delivery was a week late. The company will offer free delivery on the next order. The first apology was too vague. The email should end with a named contact.
scenes.say_uz: Yetkazib berish bir hafta kechikkan. Kompaniya keyingi buyurtmaga bepul yetkazib berishni taklif qiladi. Birinchi uzr juda mavhum edi. Xat aniq mas’ul shaxs bilan tugashi kerak.

scenes.title: Natijalarni bayon qilish
board: The survey revealed / showed that…
Over half of respondents (54%) said…
There was a marked / slight increase in…

examples.t: The survey revealed that over half of respondents worked from home twice a week.
examples.uz: So‘rovnoma ishtirokchilarning yarmidan ko‘pi haftada ikki kun uydan ishlashini ko‘rsatdi.

examples.t: There was a marked increase in complaints in July.
examples.uz: Iyulda shikoyatlar sezilarli oshdi.

scenes.say_native: Endi findings tili. Odatda o‘tgan zamon ishlatiladi, chunki tadqiqot tugagan: the survey revealed, showed, indicated. Raqamlarni so‘z bilan aylantiring: over half of respondents, keyin qavsda foiz. O‘zgarishni ot bilan bering: a marked increase, a slight decline. Respondents so‘zi muhim: so‘rovnomaga javob berganlar. Natijada baho bermang, faqat faktni ayting.
scenes.say: The survey revealed that over half of respondents worked from home twice a week. There was a marked increase in complaints in July.
scenes.say_uz: So‘rovnoma ishtirokchilarning yarmidan ko‘pi haftada ikki kun uydan ishlashini ko‘rsatdi. Iyulda shikoyatlar sezilarli oshdi.

scenes.title: Miqdor va ehtiyotkor ifoda
board: the vast majority (90%+) · a majority · a third · a small minority
appears to · tends to · suggests
a significant proportion of staff

examples.t: A small minority of staff found the system difficult to use.
examples.uz: Xodimlarning oz qismi tizimni ishlatishni qiyin deb topdi.

examples.t: The data suggests that training improves retention.
examples.uz: Ma’lumotlar treninglar xodimlarni ushlab qolishni yaxshilashini ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.say_native: Raqamlarni so‘z bilan ifodalash uchun shkala: the vast majority, ya’ni mutlaq ko‘pchilik, a majority, a third, a quarter, a small minority. Proportion so‘zi ulush degani. Agar ma’lumot faqat ishora qilsa, ehtiyotkor fe’l tanlang: suggests, appears to, tends to. Data so‘zi Britaniya ish yozuvida ko‘pincha birlik bilan ishlatiladi, ilmiy matnda esa ba’zan ko‘plik bilan: the data show.
scenes.say: A small minority of staff found the system difficult to use. The data suggests that training improves retention.
scenes.say_uz: Xodimlarning oz qismi tizimni ishlatishni qiyin deb topdi. Ma’lumotlar treninglar xodimlarni ushlab qolishni yaxshilashini ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Xulosa va tavsiyaning farqi
board: Conclusion = what it means
Recommendation = what to do
It can be concluded that… · Overall, …

examples.t: Overall, the new system has reduced waiting times.
examples.uz: Umuman olganda, yangi tizim kutish vaqtini qisqartirdi.

examples.t: It can be concluded that staff need more training.
examples.uz: Xodimlarga ko‘proq trening kerak degan xulosaga kelish mumkin.

scenes.say_native: Xulosa va tavsiyani aralashtirmang. Xulosa faktlar nimani anglatishini aytadi: overall, the new system has reduced waiting times. Tavsiya esa nima qilish kerakligini: the system should be extended. Xulosada yangi ma’lumot bo‘lmaydi, u faqat natijalarni umumlashtiradi.
scenes.say: A conclusion says what the findings mean. A recommendation says what should be done. Overall, the new system has reduced waiting times.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa natijalar nimani anglatishini aytadi. Tavsiya nima qilish kerakligini aytadi. Umuman olganda, yangi tizim kutish vaqtini qisqartirdi.

scenes.title: Tavsiya grammatikasi
board: It is recommended that the company (should) introduce…
We recommend introducing… / We recommend that staff be trained.
The system should be extended to all branches.

examples.t: It is recommended that the company introduce flexible hours.
examples.uz: Kompaniyaga moslashuvchan ish vaqtini joriy etish tavsiya etiladi.

examples.t: We recommend extending the trial for three months.
examples.uz: Sinov muddatini uch oyga uzaytirishni tavsiya qilamiz.

scenes.say_native: Tavsiyaning uch asosiy shakli. Birinchisi: recommend that, keyin fe’lning birinchi shakli, s qo‘shimchasiz: the company introduce. Bu subjunctive deyiladi. Britaniyada should introduce ham keng tarqalgan. Ikkinchisi: recommend va -ing: we recommend extending the trial. Uchinchisi: should va majhul nisbat: the system should be extended. Hisobotda shaxssiz shakl, it is recommended that, eng rasmiy.
scenes.say: It is recommended that the company introduce flexible hours. We recommend extending the trial for three months. The system should be extended to all branches.
scenes.say_uz: Kompaniyaga moslashuvchan ish vaqtini joriy etish tavsiya etiladi. Sinovni uch oyga uzaytirishni tavsiya qilamiz. Tizimni barcha filiallarga kengaytirish kerak.

scenes.title: Tavsiyaning kuchi
board: strong: It is essential that… · must
neutral: should · We recommend…
soft: It may be advisable to… · Consideration should be given to…

examples.t: It is essential that all data be backed up daily.
examples.uz: Barcha ma’lumotlarning har kuni zaxira nusxasi olinishi shart.

examples.t: Consideration should be given to hiring a part-time assistant.
examples.uz: Yarim stavkali yordamchi yollash masalasini ko‘rib chiqish kerak.

scenes.say_native: Tavsiyaning kuchini tanlay olish C1 belgisi. Kuchli: it is essential that, keyin yana fe’lning birinchi shakli: all data be backed up. Neytral: should, we recommend. Yumshoq: it may be advisable to yoki consideration should be given to, ya’ni bu masalani ko‘rib chiqish kerak.
scenes.say: It is essential that all data be backed up daily. Consideration should be given to hiring a part-time assistant.
scenes.say_uz: Barcha ma’lumotlarning har kuni zaxira nusxasi olinishi shart. Yarim stavkali yordamchi yollash masalasini ko‘rib chiqish kerak.

scenes.title: Recommend va suggest xatolari
board: ✗ We recommend to introduce… → ✓ recommend introducing
✗ I suggest you to hire… → ✓ I suggest (that) you hire…
✗ It is recommended to the company that… → ✓ It is recommended that the company…
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek va rus tilidan ko‘chiriladigan xatolar. Recommend to introduce xato, chunki recommend dan keyin to-infinitive kelmaydi: recommend introducing. Suggest you to hire ham xato: I suggest that you hire yoki I suggest hiring. Rus tilidagi предлагаю вам ta’sirida ko‘p uchraydi. Va it is recommended to the company emas, it is recommended that the company.
scenes.say: Not: we recommend to introduce, but we recommend introducing. Not: I suggest you to hire, but I suggest that you hire, or I suggest hiring.
scenes.say_uz: We recommend to introduce emas, we recommend introducing. I suggest you to hire emas, I suggest that you hire yoki I suggest hiring.

scenes.title: Natijadan tavsiyaga
board: 1) 70% of staff have never had cybersecurity training.
2) The canteen is overcrowded between 12 and 1.
3) Online sales rose by 40%, but the website crashed twice.
scenes.say_native: Endi har bir natijadan tavsiya yozing. Har safar boshqa shakl ishlating: birinchisida it is essential that, ikkinchisida we recommend va -ing, uchinchisida should va majhul nisbat. Fe’lning to‘g‘ri shaklini tanlashga e’tibor bering, ayniqsa that dan keyin s qo‘shimchasi bo‘lmasligiga.
scenes.say: Turn each finding into a recommendation. Use it is essential that, then we recommend plus ing, then should with a passive.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir natijani tavsiyaga aylantiring. Avval it is essential that, keyin we recommend va -ing, keyin should va majhul nisbatni ishlating.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) It is essential that all staff receive cybersecurity training.
2) We recommend introducing staggered lunch breaks.
3) The website should be upgraded to cope with demand.
scenes.say_native: Namuna javoblar. Birinchisi: it is essential that all staff receive cybersecurity training, receive s siz. Ikkinchisi: we recommend introducing staggered lunch breaks, ya’ni tushlik tanaffuslarini navbatma-navbat qilish. Uchinchisi: the website should be upgraded to cope with demand. Sizning tavsiyangiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, muhimi grammatik shakl va mantiqiy bog‘liqlik.
scenes.say: It is essential that all staff receive cybersecurity training. We recommend introducing staggered lunch breaks. The website should be upgraded to cope with demand.
scenes.say_uz: Barcha xodimlar kiberxavfsizlik treningidan o‘tishi shart. Tushlik tanaffuslarini navbatma-navbat qilishni tavsiya qilamiz. Talabga bardosh berishi uchun sayt yangilanishi kerak.

scenes.title: Tinglash: hisobot loyihasi
board: Two colleagues review a draft report
Topic: staff turnover
(xodimlar almashinuvi)
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Ikki hamkasb xodimlar almashinuvi haqidagi hisobot loyihasini ko‘rib chiqmoqda. Tinglang: asosiy natija nima, loyihada qanday muammo bor va qanday tavsiya qo‘shishga kelishishadi. Bugun o‘rgangan bo‘limlar va iboralar shu suhbatda uchraydi.
scenes.say: Laura: Your findings are clear. Thirty per cent of new hires left within a year. Tom: And most cited a lack of training. Laura: Right, but in the findings you wrote, I think managers are to blame. That’s an opinion. Move it to the conclusions, and soften it. Tom: Fair point. Shall we recommend a mentoring scheme? Laura: Yes. It is recommended that every new hire be assigned a mentor.
scenes.say_uz: Laura: Natijalaring aniq. Yangi xodimlarning o‘ttiz foizi bir yil ichida ketgan. Tom: Ko‘pchiligi trening yo‘qligini sabab qilgan. Laura: To‘g‘ri, lekin natijalarda menimcha rahbarlar aybdor deb yozibsan. Bu fikr. Uni xulosalarga o‘tkaz va yumshat. Tom: To‘g‘ri gap. Murabbiylik dasturini tavsiya qilamizmi? Laura: Ha. Har bir yangi xodimga murabbiy biriktirilishi tavsiya etiladi.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1) What percentage of new hires left within a year?
2) What reason did most of them give?
3) What is wrong with Tom’s draft?
4) What do they recommend?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Yangi xodimlarning necha foizi bir yil ichida ketgan? Ularning ko‘pchiligi qanday sabab ko‘rsatgan? Tomning loyihasida qanday muammo bor va uni qanday tuzatish kerak? Ular qanday tavsiyaga kelishdi? Javoblarni inglizcha to‘liq gap bilan ayting.
scenes.say: What percentage of new hires left within a year? What reason did most give? What is wrong with Tom’s draft? What do they recommend?
scenes.say_uz: Yangi xodimlarning necha foizi bir yilda ketgan? Ko‘pchilik qanday sabab ko‘rsatgan? Tomning loyihasida nima xato? Ular nimani tavsiya qiladi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Thirty per cent.
2) A lack of training.
3) An opinion appears in the findings.
4) A mentor for every new hire.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Yangi xodimlarning o‘ttiz foizi bir yil ichida ketgan. Ko‘pchilik trening yetishmasligini sabab qilgan. Tomning xatosi: natijalar bo‘limida shaxsiy fikr, ya’ni I think managers are to blame. Uni xulosaga o‘tkazish va yumshatish kerak. Tavsiya: har bir yangi xodimga murabbiy biriktirish, va e’tibor bering, be assigned, subjunctive shakli.
scenes.say: Thirty per cent left within a year, mostly citing a lack of training. Tom put an opinion in the findings. They recommend assigning a mentor to every new hire.
scenes.say_uz: O‘ttiz foiz bir yil ichida ketgan, asosan trening yo‘qligi sababli. Tom natijalarga fikr qo‘shgan. Ular har bir yangi xodimga murabbiy biriktirishni tavsiya qilishadi.

scenes.title: Lo‘nda uslub: ortiqcha so‘zlar
board: due to the fact that → because
at this point in time → now
in order to → to · a number of → several

examples.t: Due to the fact that sales fell, we postponed the launch.
examples.uz: Sotuvlar tushgani sababli taqdimotni keyinga qoldirdik.

examples.t: Because sales fell, we postponed the launch.
examples.uz: Sotuvlar tushgani uchun taqdimotni qoldirdik.

scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi mavzu: lo‘nda uslub. Ko‘p o‘quvchilar rasmiylikni uzun so‘z bilan aralashtiradi. Due to the fact that o‘rniga because, at this point in time o‘rniga now, in order to ko‘pincha shunchaki to. Rasmiy degani murakkab degani emas. Ingliz ish yozuvida plain English tamoyili bor: har bir so‘z o‘z ishini qilishi kerak.
scenes.say: Due to the fact that sales fell, we postponed the launch. Better: because sales fell, we postponed the launch. Formal does not mean wordy.
scenes.say_uz: Sotuvlar tushgani sababli taqdimotni keyinga qoldirdik. Yaxshirog‘i: sotuvlar tushgani uchun qoldirdik. Rasmiy degani so‘zga boy degani emas.

scenes.title: Faol va majhul nisbat
board: Report findings: passive is fine (It was found…)
Emails & actions: active is clearer
We will refund you. > A refund will be issued.

examples.t: We will send the samples on Monday.
examples.uz: Namunalarni dushanba kuni yuboramiz.

examples.t: Mistakes were made.
examples.uz: Xatolar qilindi. (kim qilgani yashirilgan)

scenes.say_native: Majhul nisbat hisobotdagi natijalar uchun qulay: it was found that. Lekin xat va harakat haqida gapirganda faol nisbat aniqroq: we will send the samples on Monday. Kim nima qilishi ko‘rinadi. Ehtiyot bo‘ling: mistakes were made kabi gap javobgarlikni yashiradi va mijozga yoqmaydi. Shuning uchun uzr so‘raganda faol nisbat ishlating: we made a mistake.
scenes.say: We will send the samples on Monday. That is clearer than: the samples will be sent. And when apologising, say: we made a mistake, not: mistakes were made.
scenes.say_uz: Namunalarni dushanba kuni yuboramiz. Bu namunalar yuboriladi degandan aniqroq. Uzr so‘raganda esa xatolar qilindi emas, biz xato qildik deng.

scenes.title: Phrasal verb o‘rniga rasmiy fe’l
board: look into → investigate · find out → establish
put off → postpone · set up → establish
go up → rise / increase · cut down on → reduce

examples.t: We will investigate the cause of the delay.
examples.uz: Kechikish sababini tekshiramiz.

examples.t: The meeting has been postponed until Friday.
examples.uz: Yig‘ilish jumaga qoldirildi.

scenes.say_native: Ingliz tilida ko‘p phrasal verb larning rasmiyroq, bitta so‘zli juftligi bor. Look into o‘rniga investigate, put off o‘rniga postpone, go up o‘rniga rise yoki increase, cut down on o‘rniga reduce. Hisobotda bitta so‘zli fe’l yaxshiroq. Lekin elektron xatda hamkasbga we’ll look into it deyish mutlaqo tabiiy.
scenes.say: We will investigate the cause of the delay. The meeting has been postponed until Friday. In reports, single-word verbs usually sound more precise than phrasal verbs.
scenes.say_uz: Kechikish sababini tekshiramiz. Yig‘ilish jumaga qoldirildi. Hisobotlarda bitta so‘zli fe’llar odatda phrasal verb lardan aniqroq eshitiladi.

scenes.title: Uzun va bo‘sh gap
board: ✗ It is important to note that at this point in time a large number of customers are of the opinion that prices have gone up.
✓ Many customers now believe prices have risen.
scenes.say_native: Mana bo‘sh gapning namunasi. It is important to note that hech narsa qo‘shmaydi. At this point in time bu now. A large number of bu many. Are of the opinion that bu believe. Have gone up esa hisobotda have risen. Natijada yigirma uch so‘zli gap yetti so‘zga tushdi va ma’no o‘zgarmadi.
scenes.say: Many customers now believe prices have risen. Seven words instead of twenty-three, and nothing is lost.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘p mijozlar endi narxlar oshgan deb hisoblaydi. Yigirma uch so‘z o‘rniga yetti so‘z, va hech narsa yo‘qolmadi.

scenes.title: Gapni qisqartiring
board: 1) In the event that you are unable to attend, please inform us.
2) We are writing in order to make an enquiry with regard to prices.
3) A decision was made by the board to put off the project.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Uchta uzun gapni lo‘nda va rasmiy qiling. Birinchisida in the event that ni qisqartiring. Ikkinchisida bir nechta ortiqcha birikma bor. Uchinchisida majhul nisbat va phrasal verb ni o‘zgartiring, ya’ni boardni ega qiling. Ma’no va rasmiy ohang saqlansin, gap esa sezilarli qisqarsin.
scenes.say: Make each sentence shorter and clearer. Keep the meaning and a formal tone.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapni qisqaroq va aniqroq qiling. Ma’no va rasmiy ohangni saqlang.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) If you cannot attend, please let us know.
2) We are writing to enquire about prices.
3) The board decided to postpone the project.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchisi: if you cannot attend, please let us know. In the event that va are unable to o‘rniga oddiy if va cannot. Ikkinchisi: we are writing to enquire about prices. In order to make an enquiry with regard to uchta so‘zga aylandi. Uchinchisi: the board decided to postpone the project. A decision was made by o‘rniga faol fe’l decided, put off o‘rniga postpone.
scenes.say: If you cannot attend, please let us know. We are writing to enquire about prices. The board decided to postpone the project.
scenes.say_uz: Qatnasha olmasangiz, bizga xabar bering. Narxlar haqida surishtirish uchun yozmoqdamiz. Boshqaruv loyihani keyinga qoldirishga qaror qildi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: ish so‘zlarida urg‘u
board: a SURvey /ˈsɜːveɪ/ (n) · to surVEY /səˈveɪ/ (v)
ANalyse /ˈænəlaɪz/ · aNALysis /əˈnæləsɪs/
recomMEND /ˌrekəˈmend/ · recommenDAtion

examples.t: We surveyed 200 customers. The survey took a week.
examples.uz: Ikki yuz mijoz o‘rtasida so‘rov o‘tkazdik. So‘rovnoma bir hafta davom etdi.

scenes.say_native: Hisobotni og‘zaki taqdim etganda urg‘u muhim. Survey ot bo‘lsa urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda: a survey; fe’l bo‘lsa ikkinchisida: to survey. Analyse da urg‘u boshida, analysis da esa ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda. Recommend da urg‘u oxirgi bo‘g‘inda, recommendation da esa da bo‘g‘inida. Britaniyada analyse s bilan, Amerikada analyze z bilan yoziladi, talaffuz bir xil.
scenes.say: A survey, to survey. Analyse, analysis. Recommend, recommendation. We surveyed two hundred customers, and the survey took a week.
scenes.say_uz: So‘rovnoma, so‘rov o‘tkazmoq. Tahlil qilmoq, tahlil. Tavsiya qilmoq, tavsiya. Ikki yuz mijoz o‘rtasida so‘rov o‘tkazdik va so‘rovnoma bir hafta davom etdi.

scenes.title: Hisobot bo‘limi yozing
board: Survey of 80 gym members:
65% say the gym is too crowded after 6 p.m.
40% would use it before 8 a.m. if it opened earlier
Few complaints about prices
scenes.say_native: Endi asosiy yozma topshiriq. Ekrandagi so‘rovnoma natijalari asosida hisobotning uchta bo‘limini yozing: Findings, Conclusions va Recommendations. Har bo‘limda ikki-uch gap yetarli. Raqamlarni so‘z bilan bering, xulosada baho bering, tavsiyada esa kamida bitta recommend that va bitta should ishlating.
scenes.say: Using the survey results on the board, write three short sections: findings, conclusions and recommendations.
scenes.say_uz: Ekrandagi so‘rovnoma natijalaridan foydalanib, uchta qisqa bo‘lim yozing: natijalar, xulosalar va tavsiyalar.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: Findings: Almost two thirds of members reported overcrowding after 6 p.m.
Conclusions: Evening demand exceeds capacity.
Recommendations: It is recommended that the gym open at 6 a.m.; price increases should be avoided.
scenes.say_native: Namuna. Findings: almost two thirds of members reported overcrowding after six p.m., and forty per cent would train before eight if the gym opened earlier. Prices caused few complaints. Conclusions: evening demand exceeds capacity, while there is unmet demand in the morning. Recommendations: it is recommended that the gym open at six a.m. Open s siz, chunki subjunctive.
scenes.say: Almost two thirds of members reported overcrowding after six p.m. Evening demand clearly exceeds capacity. It is recommended that the gym open at six a.m.
scenes.say_uz: A’zolarning qariyb uchdan ikki qismi kechki oltidan keyin tirbandlik borligini aytdi. Kechki talab sig‘imdan aniq oshib ketadi. Zalni ertalab oltida ochish tavsiya etiladi.

scenes.title: Ilova xat yozing
board: To: Mr Davies (gym director)
Purpose: send the report, highlight one key recommendation
Ask for a meeting next week
scenes.say_native: Oxirgi yozma topshiriq. Hisobotni zal direktori janob Daviesga yuboradigan qisqa xat yozing. To‘g‘ri murojaat, maqsadni aytadigan birinchi gap, ilova haqida ibora, bitta asosiy tavsiya, uchrashuv so‘rovi va to‘g‘ri yakun bo‘lsin. Besh-olti gapdan oshirmang.
scenes.say: Write a short covering email to Mr Davies. Attach the report, highlight one recommendation and ask for a meeting next week.
scenes.say_uz: Janob Daviesga qisqa ilova xat yozing. Hisobotni ilova qiling, bitta tavsiyani ta’kidlang va kelasi haftaga uchrashuv so‘rang.

scenes.title: Namuna xat
board: Dear Mr Davies,
Please find attached the report on member satisfaction. Its key recommendation is to open at 6 a.m.
I would be grateful if we could discuss this next week.
Yours sincerely,
scenes.say_native: Namuna xat. Dear Mr Davies. Please find attached the report on member satisfaction. Its key recommendation is that the gym open at six a.m. to reduce evening overcrowding. I would be grateful if we could discuss this next week. I look forward to hearing from you. Yours sincerely. E’tibor bering: xat hisobotni takrorlamaydi, faqat eng muhim fikrni beradi va keyingi qadamni so‘raydi.
scenes.say: Dear Mr Davies, please find attached the report on member satisfaction. Its key recommendation is that the gym open at six a.m. I would be grateful if we could discuss this next week.
scenes.say_uz: Hurmatli janob Davies, a’zolar qoniqishi haqidagi hisobot ilova qilingan. Asosiy tavsiya: zalni ertalab oltida ochish. Buni kelasi hafta muhokama qilsak, minnatdor bo‘lardim.

scenes.title: Xulosa
board: Report: Introduction → Findings → Conclusions → Recommendations
Email: Dear Mr X / Yours sincerely · I would be grateful if…
recommend + -ing / that + base form
Cut empty words; prefer clear verbs
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Hisobot to‘rt bo‘limdan iborat va har bo‘limning o‘z vazifasi bor: natija fakt, xulosa ma’no, tavsiya harakat. Rasmiy xatda murojaat va yakun mos bo‘lsin, so‘rov muloyim bo‘lsin. Recommend dan keyin -ing yoki that va fe’lning birinchi shakli. Va hamma joyda lo‘nda yozing: bo‘sh so‘zlarni olib tashlang, aniq fe’l tanlang.
scenes.say: Reports move from findings to conclusions to recommendations. Emails need the right greeting, a polite request and the right closing. And concise always beats wordy.
scenes.say_uz: Hisobot natijalardan xulosaga, xulosadan tavsiyaga o‘tadi. Xatga to‘g‘ri murojaat, muloyim so‘rov va to‘g‘ri yakun kerak. Lo‘nda yozuv doim uzun yozuvdan yaxshi.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Homework: a 250-word report with recommendations
Check: 4 headed sections · 3 recommendation forms · no opinions in Findings
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: o‘zingiz tanlagan mavzuda, masalan ish joyingiz yoki o‘quv markazingiz haqida, ikki yuz ellik so‘zli hisobot yozing. Mezon: to‘rtta sarlavhali bo‘lim, natijalarda shaxsiy fikr yo‘q, tavsiyalarda kamida uch xil shakl ishlatilgan va ortiqcha so‘zlar olib tashlangan. Keyingi darsda fan va texnologiya mavzusida munozara qilishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: For homework, write a two-hundred-and-fifty-word report with recommendations. Next time, we discuss science and technology.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: tavsiyalari bor ikki yuz ellik so‘zli hisobot yozing. Keyingi darsda fan va texnologiyani muhokama qilamiz.

homework_uz: O‘zingiz tanlagan mavzuda (masalan, ish joyingiz yoki o‘quv markazingiz haqida) tavsiyalari bor 250 so‘zli hisobot yozing. Mezon: to‘rtta sarlavhali bo‘lim (Introduction, Findings, Conclusions, Recommendations), natijalarda shaxsiy fikr yo‘q, tavsiyalarda kamida uch xil shakl (recommend + -ing, recommend that + fe’l, should + majhul) ishlatilgan va ortiqcha so‘zlar olib tashlangan.

quiz.q: Which section of a report should contain only facts and figures?
quiz.why_uz: Findings bo‘limi faqat aniqlangan faktlarni beradi. Baho xulosaga, harakat tavsiyaga tegishli.

quiz.q: Which is the best opening for a report?
options: In this report I will tell you about our sales.
Hello, this is a report about sales.
The aim of this report is to analyse last quarter’s sales.
I want to write about sales because it is important.
quiz.why_uz: Hisobot shaxssiz va aniq maqsad bilan boshlanadi: the aim of this report is to.

quiz.q: You begin 'Dear Sir or Madam'. How do you end (British English)?
quiz.why_uz: Ism noma’lum bo‘lsa, Britaniya qoidasi bo‘yicha Yours faithfully. Yours sincerely ism ma’lum bo‘lganda.

quiz.q: Your contact is Akmal Karimov. Which greeting is correct?
quiz.why_uz: Mr faqat familiya bilan ishlatiladi va murojaatdan keyin vergul qo‘yiladi.

quiz.q: I look forward to ___ from you.
quiz.why_uz: Look forward to dagi to predlog, shuning uchun undan keyin -ing shakli keladi.

quiz.q: We recommend ___ the trial for three months.
quiz.why_uz: Recommend dan keyin -ing yoki that + fe’l keladi. Recommend to extend o‘zbek o‘quvchilarining tipik xatosi.

quiz.q: It is recommended that every new employee ___ a mentor.
quiz.why_uz: Recommended that dan keyin subjunctive: fe’lning birinchi shakli, majhulda be + V3. Britaniyada should be assigned ham to‘g‘ri.

quiz.q: Which sentence is the most concise?
options: Due to the fact that costs rose, we cut staff.
Because costs rose, we cut staff.
Owing to the fact of the rise of costs, staff were cut by us.
At this point in time, because of rising costs, staff cutting happened.
quiz.why_uz: Because due to the fact that ning lo‘nda muqobili. Qolgan variantlar ortiqcha so‘z va noqulay majhul nisbatga ega.

quiz.q: Choose the most formal equivalent of 'look into the problem'.
quiz.why_uz: Look into ning rasmiy bitta so‘zli juftligi investigate. Hisobotda shunday fe’llar aniqroq.

quiz.q: Where is the stress in the noun 'survey'?
quiz.why_uz: Ot sifatida survey birinchi bo‘g‘inda urg‘u oladi, fe’l sifatida esa ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda: to surVEY.
